author: Priya S.
text: We went on Thursday around 6:30 PM, party of 4. The food was good but we waited about 35 minutes just for our appetizers and nobody told us why. Service was friendly once things arrived.

author: Marcus T.
text: Dinner on Tuesday at about 7 PM, just the two of us. I asked for my steak medium and it came out well done and dry. The server offered to remake it but we were already hungry and it felt rushed.

author: Elena R.
text: Sunday evening, around 6 PM, party of 3. We waited close to 40 minutes for our mains and the soup arrived lukewarm. The staff was apologetic but it was disappointing for the price.

author: Dan K.
text: Our table of 10 on Friday around 8 PM was completely ignored. We waited an hour and nobody took our order. Absolutely the worst service I have ever experienced.

author: Chris W.
text: Stopped in for a quick lunch around 1 PM on Tuesday and the host said the kitchen wasn't ready. We stood at the door for 20 minutes before giving up. Unwelcoming.

author: Jordan P.
text: We had a reservation for 8 people on Saturday at 9 PM and they lost it, then made us wait 50 minutes for a table. Management did not care at all. Do not go here.

author: A. Smith
text: Awful experience. We were there Saturday around 8 PM and the staff was rude, the food was cold and everything took forever. Never coming back.

author: Lee M.
text: Worst dinner of my life. Got sick after eating there on Friday. Filthy place and terrible food, stay away from this restaurant.
